name: Bayesian regime posterior for delayed residual measurements
status: Exploratory follow-up on previously inspected public unseen splits; not a fresh blind test
fit: Original train only; retain exported feature order and base model
selection: Only original valid+test and same predefined synthetic shifts as v5, delays5/20 phases0/2. Bayesian online changepoint configurations hazard per measurement [.002,.01,.05], observation-noise multipliers [1,1.5,2], reset prior width [4,16]. Prefer original-development RMSE ratio vs GRAPE <=1.02; select mean scenario ratio. All candidates saved.

evaluation.primary: mean relative RMSE improvement over original GRAPE for delays 5 and 20 across both datasets and all phases >=10%, no dataset-delay mean regression >2%, P90 regression <=5%
evaluation.simple_baseline_gate: mean RMSE improvement vs reset EMA >=5%, both datasets non-worse at delays5/20
evaluation.uncertainty: 5000 paired moving-block bootstrap, length50, shared sampled time blocks across phases; no independent-seed claims
evaluation.causality: Labels unavailable until requested and timestamp+delay reached. Own prediction always precedes own label. All methods have identical query schedule. No future covariates supplied to models.
evaluation.limits: Sample delay is an imposed stress test, not measured manufacturing wall time; no manufacturing cost/safety/novelty claim.

prior_evidence: v4 and v5 preserved. v5 improved dataset1 but regressed on dataset2. Exploratory sequential model development, not independent confirmation.
source: Adams & MacKay, Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection, arXiv:0710.3742; Gaussian known-noise conjugate implementation, not a claimed new algorithm
approximation: At most32 Gaussian components; moment-match adjacent components minimizing probability-weighted KL loss. Inspired by Bagel arXiv2611.03230, not a full reproduction. Fixed before development.
